title: Rollers about
description: A ruled band split into halves by a hairline: a 4:3 team photo on the left, and on the right a two-tone statement (orange, then charcoal) in a Helvetica-style grotesk, quiet olive-grey paragraphs and a charcoal pill beside an orange button. The hairlines draw themselves in, the statement's words rise, the photo, paragraphs and buttons fade up.
notes: the statement reads the rollers theme's --typeface-grotesk and falls back to the body face under other themes
